upload.prompt: Drag more files here or choose them from your computer

home.title: No reviews yet
home.description: Load the documents you are about to send or sign. ARGUS compares them with each other and shows you the differences before you finish.
home.note: Files are analyzed on this computer.

engineUnavailable.what: The analysis engine is not responding.
engineUnavailable.why: Without the engine, ARGUS can't read or compare files.
engineUnavailable.todo: Retry the connection. If it still doesn't respond, close ARGUS and open it again.

newReview.title: New review
newReview.sessionNameRequired: Enter a name for the session.
newReview.filesHint: Check what was read in each one before continuing
newReview.noFiles: No files yet. Add them with the drop zone.
newReview.localNote: Files are read on this computer. They are not sent to the internet.

notIncluded.one: {count} file won't be included in the review because it couldn't be read.
notIncluded.other: {count} files won't be included in the review because they couldn't be read.

analysisFailed.todo: Check that ARGUS is still open and try again. Your files are still loaded.

no_text.why: It's a scanned image with no text.
no_text.todo: Upload it again with selectable text.

encrypted.why: To compare it, ARGUS needs to open it.
encrypted.todo: Save it without a password and load it again.

corrupted.why: The file is damaged or incomplete.
corrupted.todo: Open it in its program, save it again and load it.

too_large.why: The file is larger than 10 MB.
too_large.todo: Save it without embedded images or split it into two files.

not_found.why: The file was moved or deleted.
not_found.todo: Find it and load it again.

unsupported_format.why: ARGUS reads PDF, DOCX, XLSX, EML and text.
unsupported_format.todo: Export it as PDF or DOCX and load it again.

comparedFiles.one: {count} file was compared and its values match.
comparedFiles.other: {count} files were compared and their values match.

results.activeFilters: There are {count} active filters. Clear them or search for the value in the documents.
results.searchInDocuments: Search for the value in the documents.

alertDetail.label: Alert {number}
alertDetail.allDecided: Every alert has a decision. Close the review to keep it in the history.
alertDetail.readOnly: Review closed on {date}. Its decisions are read-only.

alertTitles.contract_id: The contract number doesn't match between two documents
alertTitles.organization_name: The company name is written differently
alertTitles.referenced_period: The email cites a different period than its attachment
alertTitles.out_of_pattern: A date stands apart from the rest of the documents
alertTitles.magnitude: The same amount appears with a different scale
alertTitles.amount_in_words: The amount in words does not match the number
alertTitles.total_mismatch: The total is not the sum of its values
alertTitles.date_order: The end date is before the start date
alertTitles.impossible_date: A date does not exist in the calendar

closeFailed.what: The review could not be closed.
closeFailed.why: The analysis engine did not respond.
closeFailed.todo: Try again. Your decisions are already saved.

decisionCard.none: No decisions in this session yet.

decisionFailed.what: The decision on Alert {number} was not saved.
decisionFailed.why: The analysis engine did not respond; the alert is still pending.

decisionNotice.undoFailed: It could not be undone. Try again with Ctrl Z.

decisionPanel.title: How do you want to continue?
decisionPanel.undoHint: You can undo any decision with Ctrl Z
decisionPanel.correctDescription: Both values are valid. The alert is closed with no changes.
decisionPanel.errorDescription: One of the values is wrong. It goes to the corrections list.
decisionPanel.ignoreDescription: Not relevant now. It is not corrected and stays marked as ignored.
decisionPanel.optionalHint: Optional. It helps prepare the correction.
decisionPanel.correction: Will be added to corrections: change {wrong} to {right} in {where}.

difference.dateComponent: Difference: the day, month or year of the date changes
difference.dayMonthSwap: Difference: day and month are swapped
difference.formatOnly: Difference: the same value written in another format
difference.valuesDiffer: Difference: the values do not have the same number of characters
difference.highlightNote: · different characters are highlighted and underlined
difference.referencedPeriod: Difference: the period cited in the email is not the attachment's
difference.outOfPattern: Difference: the year is decades away from the other dates
difference.magnitude: Difference: the same digits with extra or missing zeros
difference.amountInWords: Difference: the figure written in words is another one
difference.totalMismatch: Difference: the cells add up to another value
difference.dateOrder: Difference: the end comes before the start
difference.impossibleDate: Difference: that day does not exist in that month

metrics.label: Usage metrics
metrics.noClosed: No closed reviews in this period yet
metrics.errorsDetail: {count} of {total} · the rest were “It is correct” or “Ignore”
metrics.noResolved: No resolved alerts in this period yet

empty.title: No reviews in this period

failed.what: We could not load the history.

sessionFailed.what: We could not open this session.
sessionFailed.why: The analysis engine did not respond.

exportFailed.why: The analysis engine did not respond.

missing.why: The copy of the file was moved or deleted from the history folder.
missing.todo: Look for it in its original location or start a new review with the file.

unavailable.why: The analysis engine did not respond.
unavailable.todo: Try again in a few seconds.

reading.label: Reading progress
reading.comparing: Comparing the files with each other…

rowActions.copy: Copy Value A and Value B
rowActions.suppressed: Similar cases will not be alerted from the next review. You can remove it in Settings.

rowActions.copied: Value A and Value B were copied.
rowActions.copyFailed: The values could not be copied.

search.failed: We could not search: the analysis engine did not respond. Type again to retry.
search.openFailed: We could not open “{name}”. Try again.

detection.rules: Cases that do not raise alerts
detection.rulesNote: · created with “Do not alert similar cases”
detection.noRules: No cases yet. Create them with “Do not alert similar cases” in each alert’s ⋯ menu.

sensitivity.strictDescription: Also detects format-only differences and different years in dates. Allows up to 2 different characters in identifiers.
sensitivity.balancedDescription: Detects differences in identifiers, dates, amounts, names and periods. Does not alert format-only differences, such as “S.A.S.” versus “SAS” or dots in a tax ID.
sensitivity.permissiveDescription: Alerts only the clearest differences: nearly identical names and one different character in identifiers. Does not alert format-only differences.

privacy.localDescription: Files are read and compared on this computer. ARGUS does not send their content to the internet or to external servers.
privacy.retention: Keep the decision history for 90 days
privacy.retentionOn: Reviews older than 90 days, with the copy of their files, are deleted when ARGUS starts.
privacy.retentionOff: The history is kept with no time limit.
privacy.moving: Copying the history to the new folder. The analysis engine will restart when it finishes.
privacy.moved: The history is now in the new folder. The previous folder was kept; you can delete it whenever you want.

unavailable.what: We could not load these settings.
unavailable.why: They are kept by the analysis engine, which did not respond.
unavailable.todo: Retry. Language and appearance are still available.

saveFailed.why: The analysis engine did not respond.
saveFailed.todo: Retry to see the current settings and make the change again.

same_folder.what: The history is already in that folder.
same_folder.why: You chose the folder it uses now.
same_folder.todo: Choose a different folder to move it.

folder_not_writable.what: We could not move the history.
folder_not_writable.why: The chosen folder does not allow writing.
folder_not_writable.todo: Choose another folder or ask for write permission on this one.

folder_has_history.what: We did not move the history.
folder_has_history.why: The chosen folder already has an ARGUS history and we will not overwrite it.
folder_has_history.todo: Choose an empty folder or one without another history.

copy_mismatch.what: We could not finish copying the history.
copy_mismatch.why: The copy does not match the original, so ARGUS keeps using the current folder.
copy_mismatch.todo: Check the available space and choose another folder.

engine_unavailable.what: We could not move the history.
engine_unavailable.why: The analysis engine did not respond.
engine_unavailable.todo: Wait until the engine is ready and choose the folder again.

ai.description: When you ask to “Explain this change”, ARGUS sends {provider} only the two fragments of that change. Detection and analysis stay local.
ai.keyStored: Key saved in the system keychain.
ai.keyMissing: Without a key, “Explain this change” uses the local explanation.
ai.failed: AI settings could not be loaded: the analysis engine did not respond.

keychain.what: The system keychain cannot be used.
keychain.why: On Linux a keychain service (Secret Service) must be running.
keychain.todo: Start your desktop keychain and try again. Meanwhile the local explanation is used.

assistant.showHint: If you hide it, the status is still shown as text in the sidebar.
assistant.reduceMotionHint: When off, the system preference is used.

lead.tax_id: “{first}” and “{second}” cite a different tax or ID number.
lead.person_name: “{first}” and “{second}” spell a person’s name differently.
lead.organization_name: “{first}” and “{second}” spell a company name differently.

cause.transposition: The characters {a} and {b} appear in reverse order, which usually signals a typing error.

character_change.one: A single character changes, as often happens when typing.
character_change.other: {count} characters change in the same position.

cause.date_component: Only the day, month or year changes; the rest of the date matches.
cause.day_month_swap: Day and month are swapped, a common error between date formats.
cause.similar_name: The names are almost identical: an accent may be missing or a letter changed.
cause.format_only: It is the same value written another way; its meaning does not change.
cause.referenced_period: The email mentions “{mentioned}” and its attachment “{attachment}”, on the same topic, is from “{attached}”.
cause.out_of_pattern: The other dates in the documents are from other years; a gap of decades is usually a mistyped year.
cause.magnitude: The digits match but the scale does not: a zero is usually missing or extra.
cause.amount_in_words: The figure is written twice to avoid mistakes: one of them is wrong.
cause.total_mismatch: A cell may be missing from the formula, or a value changed after adding.
cause.date_order: A year or month may have been mistyped; check the whole term.
cause.impossible_date: It is usually a mistyped day or month.
cause.blank_field: Fill it in before sending or signing the document.

majority.one: Value A appears once and Value B, once.
majority.other: Value A appears {count} times and Value B only once: the error is most likely in Value B.

feedback.one: In previous reviews you marked {errors} of {count} similar alert as an error.
feedback.other: In previous reviews you marked {errors} of {count} similar alerts as an error.

internal.amount_in_words: In “{document}”, {first} is written in words as “{second}”.
internal.total_mismatch: In “{document}”, the total {first} does not match the sum of its values, {second}.
internal.date_order: In “{document}”, the start date ({first}) is after the end date ({second}).
internal.impossible_date: In “{document}”, the date {first} does not exist in the calendar.
internal.blank_field: In “{document}”, the field “{first}” was left blank.

list.title: Changes
list.importantOnly: Important changes only: numbers, dates, names and negations

detail.removedTitle: This text is missing in B
detail.addedTitle: This text was added in B
detail.modifiedTitle: The text changed between A and B

unrelated.why: Less than 20% of the text matches; they look like different documents.

inconsistencies.intro: {data} data points that do not match, searched in {documents} documents. There is no confirmed case data yet.
inconsistencies.legend: ≠ marks the value that does not match most documents.
inconsistencies.emptyDescription: The documents match in identifiers, amounts, dates, names and periods.

matrix.label: Difference matrix
matrix.intro: {documents} documents · {pairs} pairs · {different} pairs with differences. Select a cell to see the pair.

start.title: Choose two or more documents
start.description: Two to compare versions; three or more for the matrix.
start.note: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, EML or text. They are analyzed on this computer.
start.failedWhat: The documents could not be compared.
start.failedWhy: The analysis engine did not respond or stopped.
start.failedTodo: Choose the documents again to retry.

explain.failed: The change could not be explained: the analysis engine did not respond. Close it and open it again.

fallback.no_key: AI is on but the key is missing: save it in Settings > Artificial intelligence.
fallback.keychain_unavailable: The system keychain could not be read; the local explanation is shown.
fallback.provider_unavailable: The AI provider did not respond; the local explanation is shown. Try again later.
fallback.invalid_key: The provider rejected the key: check it in Settings > Artificial intelligence.
fallback.refused: The AI provider declined to explain this fragment; the local explanation is shown.

facts.intro: Confirmed data is the source of truth for the case file. Every document is compared against it.

actionTitles.retire: Stop using it as the source of truth

aside.title: Documents that contradict it
aside.pendingText: The documents give two values: {values}. Confirm the correct one to use it as the source of truth.

notes.retired: This data is retired and is not used in comparisons.

matches.one: The value matches in the document where it appears.
matches.other: The value matches in the {count} documents where it appears.

notes.notFound: The value does not appear in the documents of this case file.
notes.variant: “{value}” in {document} is accepted as the same value.
notes.rule: “{value}” is accepted by a “Don't alert similar cases” rule created on {date}.

notice.retired: “{label}” retired. It is no longer compared.

empty.title: No confirmed data yet
empty.description: Confirm the contract number, the parties, the amounts and the dates to use them as the source of truth.

loadFailed.what: The confirmed data could not be loaded.
loadFailed.why: The analysis engine did not respond.

failed.what: The change to “{label}” was not saved.
failed.unrecognized: “{value}” is not recognized as a value of the chosen type.
failed.unavailable: The analysis engine did not respond.

sending.opened: The copy of the draft was opened in your mail program.

openFailed.what: The draft could not be opened in your mail program.
openFailed.why: The analysis engine did not respond or there is no default mail program.

start.title: Check an email before sending it
start.description: Choose the draft (.eml) with its attachments. ARGUS checks the period it mentions, the attachments it promises and the recipients. It does not send the email.
start.withCaseFile: It is compared with the open case file.
start.withoutCaseFile: Without an open case file only the email is checked; with one open, attachments and contacts are compared too.

failed.what: The draft could not be checked.
failed.why: The analysis engine did not respond.

notADraft.what: The draft could not be read.
notADraft.why: The file is not an .eml email or it is damaged.
notADraft.todo: Save the email as .eml from your mail program and choose it again.

summary.review: Check each one before sending. ARGUS does not send the email.
summary.readyCaseFile: Attachments, period and recipients match the case file.
summary.readyAlone: The period and the attachments match what the email says.

high.one: {count} high-risk problem unresolved. You can open the email anyway.
high.other: {count} high-risk problems unresolved. You can open the email anyway.

period_mismatch.title: It mentions “{mentioned}” and the attachment is from another period
period_mismatch.body: The text says “{marked}”. The attachment {attached} is from another period.

missing_attachment.title: It says “{phrase}” and it is not attached

foreign_recipient.title: A recipient does not belong to the case file
foreign_recipient.body: {recipient} is not among the case file contacts.

decided.error: Problem {number}: it will be applied to the copy of the draft.

report.title: Document review report
report.heading: {number}. {title}

hints.evidence: Each value with file and location
hints.decisions: What was decided, when and the correct value
hints.ai: Recommended if the report is shared

report.aiNote: Explanations labeled “AI suggestion” were generated by the assistant and checked by the person who made the decision.
report.openFailed: The report could not be opened. Open it from the folder.

failed.what: The report could not be exported.
failed.why: The analysis engine did not respond or the Documents folder cannot be changed.

changeExplanation.negation: A negation appears or disappears: what the text allowed becomes forbidden, or the other way around.
changeExplanation.amount: An amount changes: check that the new value is the agreed one.
changeExplanation.date: A date changes: check deadlines, term and due dates.
changeExplanation.number: A number or identifier changes: it may refer to another contract or another quantity.
changeExplanation.party: One of the parties or its identification changes.
changeExplanation.case: Only capitalization changes: the meaning is the same.
changeExplanation.punctuation: Only punctuation changes: the meaning is the same.
changeExplanation.format: Only spacing or formatting changes: the meaning is the same.
changeExplanation.added: New text is added: it may create an obligation or a right that did not exist before.
changeExplanation.removed: Text is removed: it may remove an obligation, a right or a condition.
changeExplanation.moved: The text is the same, it only moved within the document.
changeExplanation.reworded: The wording changes but the meaning seems the same.
changeExplanation.meaning_change: The wording changes and what the text says seems to change too.
changeExplanation.wording: The wording changes; compare both versions to confirm the meaning is the same.

load.say: I am an AI assistant. I read your documents on this computer.
load.title: 1. Load the documents of a case file
load.body: Drag in the contract, its annexes, the rate sheet or the email you are about to send. ARGUS reads PDF, DOCX, XLSX, EML and pasted text.
load.addMore: You can add more documents at any time.

confirm.say: If I am not sure about a value, I ask you.
confirm.title: 2. Confirm what was read
confirm.body: Before comparing, check the contract number, parties, amounts and dates that were found. What you confirm stays in the case file as the source of truth.
confirm.reused: Confirmed values are used in every review of the case file.
confirm.editable: You can edit or retire them later.

decide.say: I can explain a change, but the decision is yours.
decide.title: 3. Decide on each alert
decide.body: Each alert shows both values, the file and the source page. Mark “It's correct”, “It's a mistake” or “Ignore”. AI explanations always quote the original fragment.
decide.shortcuts: Shortcuts: C, E, I. Undo with Ctrl Z.
decide.hide: You can hide the assistant in Settings.
